text: Donald Trump states potential use of broad tariffs to pressure countries over Greenland, publicly linking trade penalties to territorial aims. The remarks surface tension between executive trade powers, allied state resistance, and ongoing legal scrutiny of tariff authority.

meta.note: Hypothetical application of tariffs blurs boundary between declared policy and contingent threat.

text: OpenAI announces U.S. testing of labeled ads within ChatGPT responses for free and low-cost users, excluding paid plans and minors. Advertising is positioned as a new revenue layer alongside subscriptions, with stated boundaries on data user and topic placement.

meta.note: Ads coexist with assurances of response neutrality, creating tension between monetization layer and interface trust claims.

text: The Department of Education announces a delay of wage garnishment and Treasury Offset collections on defaulted federal student loans, affecting seizures of wages, tax refunds, and certain benefits. The pause coincides with implementation of revised payment options under recently enacted legislation.

meta.note: Repeated policy reversals create ambiguity around duration and scope of the pause.
